business_problem: Cogna’s portal faced major traffic spikes each semester, with 57K+ applicants and heavy document loads, causing latency, hardware strain, and risking delays in scholarship processing.
solution_summary: Cogna’s portal faced major traffic spikes each semester, with 57K+ applicants and heavy document loads, causing latency, hardware strain, and risking delays in scholarship processing.
